notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33510716/a0cdcaa6d06387704464f25f958431985a39da44.jpg

I got a great advice to post some updates right into Steam newsletter of Street Tuning Evolution, so here we go. First of all, 4 bodykits for Skyline confirmed:

- NISMO Z-Tune
- NISMO GT-T
- Tommy Kaira R-s
- URAS

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33510716/0684543f3d7f90502d91c4cf66fef1a2253390b7.jpg

You could use decals to make paintjobs just like in Street Legal:

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33510716/6e5381e12d2397ce34b44105dd83b3444019d3ff.jpg

Exterior work for the Supra is almost finished:

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33510716/90864d1327148be6d3c7ac1d93853857df803042.jpg

Engines could be disassembled to about 40 parts with some nice level of detail:

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33510716/70f01ff4a65c4d3a3fa6cda15e47861617aae968.jpg

I'll keep posting more news from time to time. If you ilke this project, add it to your wishlist or visit our Patreon page
